## Budget vs Actual

A variance report for the year to date. Fields: `asOfMonth` (the last closed month compared), `thresholdPct` and `thresholdMinor` (a variance is flagged only when it exceeds both), and `budget`, a `linksTo(Budget)`.

### Queries
- `closes`: `linksToMany(MonthClose)` from January of the `asOfMonth` year (`fromMonth`, computed) through `asOfMonth`; actuals come from each close's account `totals`.
- `accounts`: `linksToMany(LedgerAccount)`, to classify accounts and name them.

### Computed
`rows` (`VarianceRow`) has one row per income, cost of goods sold or expense account found in the budget or the actuals: the month's budget and actual, year-to-date budget and actual, the year's budget, `varianceMinor` (positive is favourable), `varianceBp` (variance ÷ budget in basis points) and `flag` (`unfavourable`, `favourable` or empty). Year to date is the `@cardstack/bxl` formula `SUMIF(month, "<=" & k, amounts)` over the budget's monthly spread and the actuals. Totals: `netBudgetYtdMinor`, `netActualYtdMinor` and `flaggedCount` (the unfavourable rows).

The card has no operations.

```ts
import { BudgetVsActual } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-analysis';
```

### Non-goals
Compares closed months only; no commentary or explanations per variance, and no reforecasting (see P&L Forecast).

### Example
`Reports/budget-vs-actual-2026-09`, nine months against the 2026 budget.
attributes.cardDescription: Closed months against the budget, with year-to-date variance by account and the accounts over threshold flagged.
